_comment: Prototype params (aging D5-b: every choice is a versioned file). Nextflow reads the same file via -params-file.

fetch._max_file_mb: PXD027318's three largest raw files are 1.62-1.63 GB, so the 1500 MB ceiling used for PXD036557 would have silently dropped Q2, Q3 and P1 - three of the six files of the quiescence arm. Raised to admit all 18.

qc._rule: v1 keeps only high-res HCD with MS2 read in the Orbitrap (user, 2026-09-18)

_run: Second dataset. PXD027318, 'Senescence Biomarker Discovery by LC-MS-based Proteomics' (Delfarah et al.): 18 raw, 20.4 GB, primary human mammary epithelial cells (HMEC), WHOLE CELL LYSATE, label-free DDA, Q Exactive Plus. Chosen to complement PXD036557: same size and instrument family, but an unfractionated whole-cell proteome (so GO/organelle mapping is not distorted by a subcellular fraction) and three independent routes into senescence - replicative (A-sen/C-sen vs D-young/H-young), telomerase immortalisation (E-hTERT vs E-Luc) and quiescence (Q1-3 vs P1-3). The conditions are readable from the file names, which is the G2 no-design fallback this pipeline will need. NOTE: the 18 files span three acquisition dates (2017-11-20, 2018-01-02, 2021-05-17) with visibly different gradient lengths, so batch structure is expected and MBR across the three arms should be treated with suspicion.
